name: Per-month row: days, victims, per day, Sweden, groups match the stats file
Sector grid: 17 sectors + Other, largest first, Other last, shares add up
Top groups: 10, the busiest first, with claims and share
A note says where the statistics start
No errors or CSP violations in the console
The month picker changes the groups list; November shows ▲/▼/new marks, October (first month) none
Two months give two grid columns and a change mark in each November cell
Default: today's issue is shown, Trends is closed and no statistics are fetched
Clicking Trends loads the statistics once, hides the issue and sets #trends in the address
The back button returns to today's issue
Keyboard: arrow keys and Home switch tabs and move focus
One tab stop for the tab list (the selected tab)
#trends opens straight to Trends, full width, without the archive sidebar
Without the stats file, Trends says so and the page keeps working
360 px with six months: no page-wide sideways scroll; the sector grid scrolls in its own box
Keyboard: Tab reaches the per-month table, the sector grid and the month picker
CSP on the Breaches page is unchanged and the same as the other pages
